summary: @ornikar/typed-css-modules-loader ships preinstall Bun-runtime dropper executing obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, unpacks and chmods the Bun binary, then invokes it via execFileSync to run a sibling file math_init.js at install time. math_init.js is a 727KB file prefixed `// @bun @bun-cjs` and heavily obfuscated with string-array rotation and a custom-charset decoder — its behavior is not inspectable prior to execution and it is intentionally not runnable under Node, so it evades tools that only trace Node-reachable code. The package is published under the `@ornikar` scope but its package.json repository/bugs URLs point at github.com/olegstepura/typed-css-modules-loader, an unrelated upstream author whose real package has neither a preinstall hook nor any Bun dependency — a scope-impersonation shape used to smuggle the dropper to consumers who assume an org-scoped fork of the legitimate loader. Installing this package causes the downloaded Bun binary to execute attacker-supplied obfuscated code with the installer's permissions on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
